# Provenance: tests/fixtures/mse

## Classification: C — project-generated (data) + project-authored (harness)

`init-{video,audio,av1}.mp4`, `{video,audio,av1}-N.m4s`,
`whole-{video,audio,av1}.mp4`, `MANIFEST.txt` are produced by
`tests/unit/gen_mse.sh`, whose header states:

> "build the MSE fixture: a DASH-shaped stream ... Deterministic sources, no
> input file: this is committed, and a from-scratch H.264 decoder under TCG
> pays for every macroblock."

Synthetic sources (`testsrc2`/`sine` lavfi), encoded High-profile H.264 (the
header explains why: matching what a real DASH manifest offers, e.g.
bilibili's `avc1.640033`, without using any of that manifest's actual bytes).
`MANIFEST.txt`'s first line, `# generated by tests/unit/gen_mse.sh -- do not
edit`, confirms this directly. `mse-page.html` is a hand-written test harness
page (`<script>` driving `MediaSource`/`SourceBuffer`), project-authored, not
third-party.

## Consuming gates

`tests/mse.mk` (`test-mse`, `test-mse-os`, etc.), `$(DISK)` (packs
`init-video.mp4` and others onto the disk). Not touched by this pass —
class C, outside the class-A removal mandate.

## History

Generated/committed alongside the MSE work; `tests/unit/gen_mse.sh` is the
generator of record.
